steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title before continuing.
Choose an RFQ template so the product sheet becomes available.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, add the CYLINDER product, select CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Quantity Requested to 10, choose Plant Name (LOC-0001) as Delivery location, open the Terms and Conditions area, open Recent Event Terms, select one recent event term, and stop with the selected event clauses visibly copied into this event.

steps.note: Complete and verify the buyer-side interactions for product selection, line-item fields, Recent Event Terms, and clause copying.
Assert that the resulting event screen still visibly shows the terms area after reuse.
